risk_note: RV2 by path, read only. adminListUnknownPayouts threw for a PAYING needs_manual withdrawal without any kind=transfer attempt, so the whole page answered 500. Such a row is now listed (first_transfer_at null, after every row with a T, then by withdrawal_id; fail_blockers resolve_too_early, resolve_bill_unverifiable, resolve_query_unverifiable) and each one logs a warning naming its withdrawal_id (no phone, account or name), so how it got there can be traced. The order is explicit (nulls last). adminResolveUnknownPayout is unchanged (20902 for such a withdrawal). payout.module.ts only injects the root logger into the list's read dependencies. No money moves, no write path changed.

spec_test_review.note: Codex wrote the rule tests in 2 attempts (the first seeded a second transfer attempt, which payout_attempts_transfer_once_key forbids). A fresh Claude reviewed (approvals 19), static, r1 pass with one S2 left open: an implementation that warns only for the first row without a T would pass, because the logged case has one such row; the implementation warns per row. Mutations run by the author and reverted: dropping the warning turns #4 and #6 red, ordering null first turns #1, #3, #4 and #6 red, all by assertion.
